name: Blomberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Blomberg (a white castle with three towers and a rose on green).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of May 1976 the city was granted the right to bear a banner and a flag.

features.role: Blomberg arms — white castle with rose on green
